pillar.description: Short lowercase code. Must match the file name, and prefixes every system id.

external.description: Every system here is reached by outside callers, unless it says otherwise.

scope.description: How the environments' scope rules spell this pillar.

code.description: What {pillar} stands for in the scope rules of the environment files. Without it, the pillar id.

id.description: pillar.system, lowercase kebab-case, unique in the town.

service.description: Systems that share a service are drawn side by side on one pad (an API, its worker and its database).

serviceCode.description: The name this system's resources carry for its service: matched with the service group of the patterns under scope.resources in the environment files. Without it, the service name.

telemetry.description: What the telemetry says about this system.

role.description: The name the telemetry gives this system (its role name). Without it, the environment's scope.telemetryRole template, if it has one.

tenantPattern.description: For a database (role: db) that keeps one database per tenant: its name with {tenant} where the tenant id goes, for example merchant-{tenant}-db. The store then stands as a yard with one unit for each tenant of the environment.

external.description: Reached by callers outside the town.

calls.description: Systems this one calls directly. Cars drive only along these links.

gatewayCalls.description: Systems on other islands this one reaches through the API gateway. They draw the dependency overlay and decide where the cars come from.

aliases.description: Former ids of this system, so files that still use them keep working after a rename.
